meta.name: ccs-align
meta.description: Run the CCS Align seat's hourly breathing cycle — prove the local claude-mem worker is healthy, pull needle observations through search → timeline → get_observations, land them in a seat-owned middle cache via atomic grab → append → filter exclude-marks → replace, manage exclude marks, and walk house → project → seat rules to detect conflicts (SHADOW_HOUSE, DENY_ALLOW, DRIFT, CLOCK_HEADER) with an append-only rules-report.md. Use when asked to run CCS Align, breathe the alignment seat, refresh the middle cache, exclude or restore an observation, walk rules, check rules conflicts, or check the Worker Watch board.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动巡检并维护AI记忆服务,同时发现规则冲突报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你管理本地AI记忆服务,希望每小时自动检查并整理它。
copy.tagline_en: Run hourly checks on AI memory, refresh its cache, and catch rule conflicts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a local AI memory service and want its cache and rules checked hourly.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 每小时跑一次 CCS Align 呼吸周期:检查本地 claude-mem worker 健康,按 search→timeline→get_observations 拉取 needle 观察写入席位 middle 缓存,每第 6 小时检测规则冲突并追加 rules-report.md。
howto.when: 当你要求运行 CCS Align、刷新 middle 缓存、排除或恢复观察等操作时触发;原文设定它按小时在 weekday house board 上循环执行。

say.text: 走一遍 house→project→seat 规则,看有没有规则冲突

howto.what_en: Installed, Claude runs CCS Align's hourly cycle: it checks the local claude-mem worker, pulls needle observations via search → timeline → get_observations into a seat-owned middle cache, and every 6th hour reports rules conflicts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to run CCS Align, refresh the middle cache, or exclude or restore an observation; the original has it run hourly on a weekday house board.

say_en.text: Run CCS Align and land this hour's needle observations in the middle cache
say_en.note: Pulls via search → timeline → get_observations, then lands.
